name: GUOMAI Culture & Media Co., Ltd.
summary: GUOMAI Culture & Media Co., Ltd. engages in the book planning and distribution, digital content and advertising, and IP derivative and operation businesses in China. The company offers academic culture, self-help psychology, women's growth, literature, educational materials, and the fan economy products. It also provides internet services, as well as engages in public domain book publishing and distribution business. GUOMAI Culture & Media Co., Ltd. was founded in 2012 and is based in Shanghai, China.
